title: As Eagles adopt more aggressive offense, Jalen Hurts 'not afraid of making mistakes'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: As Eagles adopt more aggressive offense, Jalen Hurts 'not afraid of making mistakes'
sources.description: The Eagles have lost several offensive coordinators over the first five years of Hurts' starting career. This year, Sean Mannion brings in a system that's totally different than anything Hurts has run before.
